introduction: WOOKTOOL custom printed logo plastic measuring tapes support branded retail, promotional and private-label programs that need a practical tool with clear logo presentation. Shell color, label position, blade scale and packaging can be planned around the intended channel.
Send the target length, quantity, market, artwork and packaging reference so the factory can review the right model, print treatment and inspection points.

faq.question: Can a logo be printed on the tape measure?
faq.answer: Logo placement and printing method can be reviewed on the selected case or label surface together with packaging artwork.

faq.question: Is this suitable for promotional programs?
faq.answer: It can be considered for retail promotions, branded giveaways and private-label programs when the product format and quantity suit the campaign.

faq.question: Can the shell color be customized?
faq.answer: Shell color and other branding elements can be reviewed against the selected model and order quantity.

faq.question: What is checked before shipment?
faq.answer: Checks can include print clarity, blade readability, lock and retraction, hook rivet, package artwork and carton quantity.
